points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight layouts passed prior validator, which does not establish convergence; metadata reports M2 laminar converged prematurely.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Prior explicit examiner invocation passed all eight required output packages and report; structural scope only.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M2 laminar incorrectly marked converged despite Cd0.339895→0.167402 in final200; several below-target cases have independently bounded plateaus.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd1.993 and Re200 St~0.186 are plausible; M2 laminar is still changing, low-speed inviscid remains oscillatory, and high residuals warrant caution.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Report has case-specific fields and residuals; several common-scale force images flatten both late components and Re200 fails readable late drag floor.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Discloses limiter freezing and plateau limits but asserts no first-order fallback despite partition ghost issue, and calls M2 laminar converged despite large force drift.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Committed report figures and source; Re20 force, residual, Mach-zoom PNGs independently pixel-reproduced from named workspace inputs. Other image bindings and exact binary hash unverified.
